notes.title: ABC 2025 patch 3
notes.content: Added more levels to the game for DLC, now there is 15 levels in DLC and 6 levels in free version. Small other tweaks were also done to some other levels, such as level 5. Also now there's new target goals when you complete the level and go beyond 100 score on the level.

notes.title: ABC 2025 patch 2
notes.content:
Added 2 new levels: 11 and 12 to the DLC, and converted level 6 as a new level to the free version.

Tweaked also the other levels more as this was a major patch. This included adding new shapes and replacing poorer shape ideas that didn't work that well. In general I didn't want the game to be as much a reaction game, so I took away a shape that was flying at too fast speed. In general the levels now have more shapes that move at different velocities, as it generates more interesting levels.

Pacing change: It felt like there's not much going on in the game if the music level was low, so I added the spawning of shapes and the levels are now more intense. The level difficulty was affected and the later levels are now more difficult in general. Tried to counter the difficulty curve bump by making sure that on most levels the shapes can't spawn quite as tightly as previously.

notes.title: ABC 2025 patch 1
notes.content:
Now having some holidays from work, so it's great time to update this game!

I tweaked the level personalities, so that they differentiate more. For example now different levels might have different camera views. 
Also added some feedback from heavy bass, it gets the whole playground to bounce.
Also tweaked the level progression so that the player gets quicker more level variance when playing a level.
Also managed to create a tiny bit more variation to levels and got new ideas on what new variations could be added later. I'm now quite more happy with levels 4-6. Level 3 is even greater than before, too. Level 1 and 2 improved too.

notes.title: Small polishing
notes.content:
Improved game menus, for example the level select menu was able to show simultaneously 2 levels and it was hard to read anything.

Now the game doesn’t as easily falsely think that you want to start 2 player game, when your just clicking around with your mouse and want to play with a controller.

notes.title: Climb up the leaderboards!
notes.content:
Added Leaderboards! I havn't yet played really, so you can be world number 1 pretty easily at least for some time.. :)

For the leaderboard to work, make sure you make a new personal record as that is when the game send the new score to leaderboards, so if you have old records, they wont get there until you break them! There are different leagues for different lives amounts: 1, 3, 5, 10, 20 and infinite lives. So you can have different records for each levels in the different difficulty modes.

Also tweaked a bit the first levels, made the onboarding more smooth for new players: the first levels are a bit easier at start.

Also decreased the camera movement as it was a bit dizzying.

notes.title: Patch v.1.2 is live!
notes.content:
-Added player animation! There's a kind of trail left by player when moving.
-Graphical tweaks: tweaked the intensity of background particles, added more colours to the background, adjusted the screen center colours, adjusted chromatic abbrevation.
-Also changed the game to stop quicker after player enter main menu.
-When starting the game first time, in-game music gets activated by default to reduce the confusion of new players.

notes.title: Update Notes for 13/06/2021
notes.content:
- Made it easier to navigate through the levels: no need to go through the menu to get to the next level. Instead now player has the choice when the level is completed to either press Esc/B-button to keep playing current level further or press Enter/A-button to get to the next level.
-Now there's a tooltip on how to teleport when completing a level, there really wasn't anything to tell the player that except if player went to options menu to see controls from there.
-Changed a bit the graphics, the colour of the center to more orange as it's kind of the theme colour of the game.

notes.title: Patch v.1.1
notes.content:
Change log:
- Tweaked lvl 1 and lvl 2 starting speeds / goal speeds, the game pacing should be improved for new players
-Reintensified background particles. They move now slower than previously, so afforded to intensify them without causing hopefully too much visual distraction effect to players.
- Pause feature. The game will pause after 2 seconds when player enter the menu, this is so that player wouldn't cheat the system with the instant ability to pause.
- There's more goal scores on each level, so the urge to keep playing should be increased
- Lvl 4 had quite low background particle visibility, increased it
- Spawning triangles used to cause visual glitching at the corners of the screen
- Increased the speed that the obstacles appear at the start of the level

notes.title: hothotfix to game update
notes.content: Why it's so easy to make mistakes? hothotfix for the major game update. Now the lives reset after level change correctly, or should!

notes.title: Major Update, lives added
notes.content:
-Added lives: you can choose to play the game with infinite lives (as before) and also with 1,3,5,10 or 20 lifes before the player fail the level. There's separate highscores and unlocks for each difficulty level/game mode.
-Made the background particles a bit more easy on eyes, they are not moving as fast.
-Added needed GUI to support lives feature
-Tiny background particle quality polish, there's now also smaller particles that can be seen on the red background light.

notes.title: Regular update
notes.content:
-Multiplayer wasn't working, control improvements broke it
-Small improvement to the game behavior when hitting obstacles
-Game remembers correctly your setting if you prefer to listen your own music instead of the game's internal soundtrack.
